lean lemma sublemma_3_1 [Fintype T] (τ : Finset T) (D : Finset I) (h_door : IST.isDoor τ D) (h_nonempty : τ.Nonempty) : ∀ i ∈ D, (IST.isDominant τ (D.erase i) ↔ (∃ a b, a ∈ D ∧ b ∈ D ∧ a ≠ b ∧ mini h_nonempty a = mini h_nonempty b ∧ (i = a ∨ i = b) ∧ M_set τ D i h_nonempty = ∅))
